source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Black Widow (Yelena Belova) (archived 9 December 2015)

powerOrigins.detail: No natural powers: the Red Room trained her as a spy and fighter, and her physical test scores beat Natasha Romanova's.
Fights with Widow's Bite gauntlets, a bulletproof suit, firearms and spy gadgets, and once flew on bought copies of the Falcon's wings.

abilities.name: Red Room training
abilities.detail: The academy's top cadet, trained almost entirely in physical skills, with scores that surpassed Natasha Romanova's.

abilities.name: Master martial artist
abilities.detail: Trained in armed and unarmed combat, at peak human condition and an Olympic-level gymnast.

abilities.name: Espionage
abilities.detail: Extensively trained in spycraft, using tools such as smoke pellets, sleeping gas and lockpicks.

abilities.name: Tactician
abilities.detail: A highly intelligent tactician, though the wiki notes she lacks the psychological training most spies receive.

abilities.name: Widow's Bite gauntlets
abilities.detail: Wrist gauntlets that fire a stunning energy charge, worn with a bulletproof Black Widow uniform.

abilities.name: Adaptoid mimicry (former)
abilities.detail: When A.I.M. remade her as a Super-Adaptoid, she could copy the powers, looks and gear of super beings with one touch.

feats.text: Rebuilt by A.I.M. as a Super-Adaptoid, she attacked the New Avengers in their tower and copied their powers, including the Sentry's.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: New Avengers Annual Vol 1 1

feats.text: Using her Adaptoid powers, she overpowered Daisy Johnson and Nick Fury Jr. at an arms fair so A.I.M. could seize the Iron Patriot armor.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Secret Avengers Vol 2 3

feats.text: Turned the self-destruct systems of Armament Industries' killing machines against them and took down Renata Best, the company's hidden owner.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: White Widow Vol 1 4

feats.text: Freed the Black Widows from mind control with a grenade of Red Dust, then wrecked Dreykov's escape helicopter by jamming her baton into its rotor.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Widow (film)
Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Widow (Yelena Belova)

feats.text: Ambushed Clint Barton on a rooftop and held off Barton, Kate Bishop and Maya Lopez together with her Widow's Bite and a grapple.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Partners, Am I Right?
Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Widow (Yelena Belova)

feats.text: Planned the escape from the O.X.E. vault and, tied to Bob by a fire hose to protect him, defeated a wave of armed agents.
